name: Marko Babić
bio:
Marko Babić's journey into motorsport PR began unexpectedly after a career in journalism covering local sports. He transitioned to motorsport after befriending a rally driver and seeing the need for better media management in the sport. Marko joined Manthey EMA five years ago, bringing with him a no-nonsense approach to public relations, prioritizing clear communication and genuine relationships with journalists.

He believes in transparency and leveraging innovative communication strategies to enhance the team's image. Marko is known for his ability to navigate complex situations with grace and his dedication to safeguarding the team's reputation. He’s particularly skilled at crafting compelling narratives that resonate with fans and sponsors alike. His past experience makes him uniquely suited to deal with both the sporting and business sides of motorsport.

Marko is distinguished by his unwavering loyalty and his commitment to upholding the highest ethical standards. He sees his role as integral to the team's success both on and off the track, ensuring that the Manthey EMA brand remains synonymous with excellence and integrity.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marko is a solidly built man with a serious demeanor, often seen with a thoughtful expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with handwritten notes.
Insists on having a specific brand of herbal tea before any press conference.
Has a habit of adjusting his glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
